availability_and_rule_review.question: Will Tyrone Tracy Jr. be the highest-scoring RB of the 2026-27 NFL season?

fields.description:
This market will resolve to the running back who finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) as the highest-scoring running back under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports.

If two or more players are tied for the most total PPR fantasy points, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player that has a higher fantasy points per game average for the 2026 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player whose last name comes first alphabetically.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or a leader cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source will be official season-total statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).
fields.question: Will Tyrone Tracy Jr. be the highest-scoring RB of the 2026-27 NFL season?

availability_and_rule_review.question: Will Zane Gonzalez finish as a top-5 K in the 2026-27 NFL season?

fields.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the named kicker finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) ranked among the top 5 kickers by total fantasy points under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports. Otherwise, that market will resolve to "No".

Only regular-season games count; postseason (playoff) games are excluded. If two or more kickers are tied such that more than 5 would qualify for the top 5, the tie will be broken by higher fantasy points per game average for the 2026 NFL regular season, and if a tie still persists, by last name in alphabetical order, so that exactly 5 kickers are classified as top 5.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the rankings cannot be determined within this timeframe, all markets in this event will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season-total statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

fields.description:
This market refers to the tennis match between Matheus Pucinelli de Almeida and Joao Lucas Da Silva in the Antofagasta, originally scheduled for October 9, 2026 at 9:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Matheus Pucinelli de Almeida' if Matheus Pucinelli de Almeida advances against Joao Lucas Da Silva.

This market will resolve to 'Joao Lucas Da Silva' if Joao Lucas Da Silva advances against Matheus Pucinelli de Almeida.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by October 23, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the ATP Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

 intent=read(child/'origin_intent.json');facts=read(child/'origin_facts.json') if (child/'origin_facts.json').exists() else None

roots={'panel':panel,'selection':sel,'worker':w,'runtime':rroot,'activation':base/('fs2_activation_'+suffix)}

not a model dataset, predictive-edge result or economic-value claim.','Source event membership and economic independence remain unresolved.','Role overlap does not increase independent sample count.','Incomplete flow, persistent book windows, related-market signals and selected external relevance remain unavailable.','No redraw, retrospective threshold change or label substitution.']}

def at(value):
 if isinstance(value,dict):value=value.get('utc',value.get('$utc'))
 return datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z','+00:00'))
def us(a,b):
 d=at(a)-at(b)
 return (d.days*86400+d.seconds)*1000000+d.microseconds
origin_timing=[]
for o in origins:
 if o['facts'] is None:continue
 f=o['facts'];i=o['intent']
 origin_timing.append({'market_id':i['member']['market_id'],'origin_id':i['slot']['intent_id'],
  'scheduled_to_freeze_us':us(f['origin_at'],i['slot']['scheduled_at']),
  'freeze_to_save_us':us(o['facts_ack']['durable_ack'],f['origin_at']),

 target_details.append({'intent':intent,'facts':facts,'receipt':receipt,'receipt_ack':ack,
  'scheduled_to_durable_receipt_us':us(ack['durable_ack'],intent['job']['scheduled_at']),
  'artifacts':[artifact(p) for p in child.glob('*.json')]})
data['origin_timing']=origin_timing
data['target_details']=target_details

windows=[]

 windows.append({'entry':entry,'artifacts':[artifact(path),artifact(path.with_name(path.stem+'_ack.json'))]+[artifact(p) for root in (sockets,analysis) if root.exists() for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]})
data['windows']=windows
eligible_history=[]
for o in origins:
 if o['facts'] is None:continue
 projection=o['facts']['projection'];win=projection.get('pre_origin_window')
 if win is None:continue
 h=win['history']
 if h:
  def fraction(x):return Fraction(int(x['numerator']),int(x['denominator']))
  assert fraction(h['current_midpoint'])-fraction(h['prior_midpoint'])==fraction(h['midpoint_change'])
  assert Fraction(us(h['current_received_at'],h['prior_received_at']),1000)==fraction(h['receipt_separation_ms'])
 if (o['result']['state']=='observed' and win['eligible_at_freeze']
     and win['subscription_sent_at'] is not None
     and win['socket_terminal']=='interval_ended' and win['socket_close_state']=='closed'
     and at(win['subscription_sent_at'])<at(win['window_ended_at'])<=at(win['cutoff'])<=at(win['frozen_at'])
     and win['cutoff']==o['facts']['read_started_at'] and win['frozen_at']==o['facts']['origin_at']):
  eligible_history.append(o['intent']['member']['market_id'])
data['eligible_completed_window_history_markets']=eligible_history
data['execution_gates']['six_of_eight_completed_windows_and_history']=len(set(eligible_history))>=6
data['execution_gates']['reporting_complete']=data['execution_gates']['reporting_complete'] and len(windows)==8
window_summaries=[]
for e in windows:
 v=e['entry'];a=v['analysis'];sock=v['socket'];coverage=None
 if a:
  index=Path(e['artifacts'][0]['path']).stem.rsplit('_',1)[1]
  coverage=read(w/('fs2_socket_analysis_'+index)/'socket_analysis_facts.json')['projection']['coverage']
 window_summaries.append({'market_id':v['item']['member']['market_id'],
  'question':v['item']['identity']['question'],'missing_reason':v['missing_reason'],
  'socket':sock,'coverage':coverage})

 0 <= o['scheduled_to_freeze_us'] <= 60000000 and 0 <= o['freeze_to_save_us'] <= 5000000
 for o in origin_timing if o['market_id'] in observed)
accounting=[]
for record in windows:
 v=record['entry']; pre=read(Path(v['item']['book_root'])/'book_facts.json')
 snapshots=pre['projection']['snapshots']; eligible=False
 if len(snapshots)==1:
  snap=snapshots[0];q=snap['quote'];m=q.get('mapping')
  eligible=(snap['state']==q['state'] and q['state'] in {'observed','one_sided_or_missing'}

 sock=v['socket']; a=v['analysis']; idx=Path(record['artifacts'][0]['path']).stem.rsplit('_',1)[1]
 coverage=read(w/('fs2_socket_analysis_'+idx)/'socket_analysis_facts.json')['projection']['coverage'] if a else None
 valid_mode=(sock is not None and sock['schema_version']=='fs2-observation-socket-window-v2'
   and (coverage is None or coverage['policy']['version']=='fs2-window-coverage-policy-v2'))
 accounting.append({'market_id':v['item']['member']['market_id'],'valid_active_pre_binding':eligible,

  'missing_reason':v['missing_reason'],'socket_terminal':sock['terminal'] if sock else None,

data['independent_artifact_check_count']=len(all_artifacts)

identity.question: Will Tyrone Tracy Jr. be the highest-scoring RB of the 2026-27 NFL season?
identity.rules_text:
This market will resolve to the running back who finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) as the highest-scoring running back under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports.

If two or more players are tied for the most total PPR fantasy points, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player that has a higher fantasy points per game average for the 2026 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the tied player whose last name comes first alphabetically.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or a leader cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source will be official season-total statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

identity.question: Will Zane Gonzalez finish as a top-5 K in the 2026-27 NFL season?
identity.rules_text:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the named kicker finishes the 2026-27 NFL regular season (Weeks 1 through 18) ranked among the top 5 kickers by total fantasy points under standard PPR (points-per-reception) scoring per the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports. Otherwise, that market will resolve to "No".

Only regular-season games count; postseason (playoff) games are excluded. If two or more kickers are tied such that more than 5 would qualify for the top 5, the tie will be broken by higher fantasy points per game average for the 2026 NFL regular season, and if a tie still persists, by last name in alphabetical order, so that exactly 5 kickers are classified as top 5.

If the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past January 26, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, or the rankings cannot be determined within this timeframe, all markets in this event will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be official season-total statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).
